name: Mr. Flower
text:
1) Numen work quality cannot even be explained he is able to understand half done work or even full work don’t and be able to turn something so ordinary into something extravagant. I cannot express the amount of times we would explain some to him and he would understand it immediately. If you had to rate him or put him on a scale he would break it due to his work.

2) Numan will work like there’s no tomorrow. He woke up at 6am just to work for my game creating a whole character  and their kit (which was poorly explained) and made her into an amazing beautiful killer for my game. His speed is astronomical he finished a character we asked for in under 5 mins with no bugs or anything worked perfectly out of script.

3) If you were to hire him you wouldn’t be making a mistake, he is our most loyal scripter but also a friend I can always count on him to respond to me and answer any concerns or questions about when working.
